notes: There is one memories screen now instead of two. A character's memories, reached from their profile or from the card that slides up when you tap their picture in a chat, is the Memories tab with their name selected in the filter chips — same list, same search, same everything, filtered. A back arrow appears when you arrived from somewhere and returns you there, so it is not a one-way trip into a tab; choosing a chip yourself clears it, since that is navigating on purpose. The duplicate screen was the reason the edit pencil and the memory scan each shipped to one place and not the other, so every improvement now lands everywhere at once. Write a memory replaces the old Add Memory box at the bottom, which had its own text field, its own character dropdown and its own name for where a memory came from; it is the same editor as everywhere else, pre-set to whoever is filtered and asking when nobody is. Characters with nothing stored yet still get a chip, so arriving at an empty one shows the explanation rather than an empty screen with no way forward. Fixed underneath: switching tabs now closes whatever full-screen view was open, and the attribute that hides a button is no longer overridden by the styles of three separate button classes — that bug had been fixed one class at a time, and is now fixed once.
